readings.distinction: The prior proposals express three substantive constructions: shared negation, narrow negation with an affirmative profit alternative, and independently negative alternatives. All three are retained without counting equivalent formulas as additional readings. Shared negation is contextually preferable because profit purpose is a preceding business indicator; the Chinese negative construction offers corroboration without conclusively resolving attachment. The irregular English coordination prevents certainty. Negating the disjunction and conjoining both absences express this same reading.

vocabulary_concerns: The supplied income predicate means any income other than reimbursement of operating expenses from the family. It is neither net profit nor receipts exceeding an expense total; reimbursement from other sources is not expressly excepted. Accounting treatment and measurement period are not specified by the source.

The separate-business-assessment concern remains unresolved: the surrounding case-specific inquiry supports considering business status separately, while i.e. supports the local operational reading. Occupation or duty, continuity and capability of profit are absent from the supplied vocabulary. Treating that separate assessment as an additional antecedent requirement would change the stipulated predicate meaning; it is therefore retained here as a limitation, not as a fourth reading that overrides the required abstraction.

The profit predicate concerns the arrangement's business objective. Applying it requires distinguishing that objective from investment returns sought for family members; serving their investment needs does not itself settle its value.

The genuine-family predicate bundles genuineness, single-family status and investment-serving purpose. Q1 supplies no statutory definition of family or family office, and Q2's typical description does not make family ownership or control mandatory.

The Boolean fragment does not encode the qualified conclusion or regulatory intent. TRUE establishes only antecedent satisfaction under a proposed parse; FALSE establishes neither business status nor a licensing obligation.

Regulated activity, the intra-group carve-out and Hong Kong territorial conditions are outside these facts. The selected-slice licensing-trigger description conflicts with the narrower issue.question, which governs this proposal.

The supplied Chinese text is available; retained assertions that no parallel text was supplied are inapplicable to this packet. Its wording may inform interpretation, but correspondence, precedence and legal authority cannot be inferred from its presence, the URL or critic judgments.

The common-period assumption and any unknown or conflict evaluation conventions are modeling choices, not source-defined legal categories. No fact values are supplied here, and reported execution outcomes cannot resolve the grammatical ambiguity.

The ten prior proposals are preserved as three substantive Boolean alternatives. Equivalent formulations and repeated critic support add no interpretive authority.
